record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set hidden width to 48, dropout to 0.10 and learning rate to 6e-4. Width 48 previously matched incumbent macro HR@10; reduced dropout may compensate for its lower capacity, while the smaller learning rate may stabilize fitting. Preserve tied embeddings, six causal blocks, feature definitions, readout, scoring and loss. Retain seed 42, the 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch; synchronize checkpoint dimensions and predictor construction.

category_rationales.rationale: Jointly set width to 48, dropout to 0.10 and learning rate to 6e-4 across all four category models. Lower dropout may compensate for reduced capacity, while smaller updates may stabilize fitting. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction propagate width consistently. Preserve six causal blocks, tied embeddings, features, readout, loss, seeds and training limits.
